description: PHP command line and built-in web server (official windows.php.net build, non-thread-safe).

seedFiles.content:
; Written by OpenMind Studio. Paths are relative to this PHP, so the folder can be moved.
extension_dir = "ext"
date.timezone = UTC
memory_limit = 512M
display_errors = On
error_reporting = E_ALL
extension=curl
extension=fileinfo
extension=mbstring
extension=mysqli
extension=openssl
extension=pdo_mysql
extension=zip

notes: Official PHP for Windows (NTS, x64) from downloads.php.net; SHA256 from the release's releases.json. OpenMind Studio writes a small php.ini next to php.exe (relative paths only) that turns on curl, fileinfo, mbstring, mysqli, openssl, pdo_mysql and zip. Your machine's PHP (XAMPP, ...) is never used.
